comments.overrides: @pianissimoproject/capacitor-health-connect declares a @capacitor/core ^7 peer, but this app is on Capacitor 8 (whose Android plugin API is compatible). Override the peer so a NORMAL npm install resolves — avoiding --legacy-peer-deps, which skips ALL peer auto-installs and silently drops recharts' react-is peer, breaking the build. @capacitor/cli 8.5.0 added a direct dependency on xcode@^3.0.1, which pins uuid@^7.0.3 (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, moderate: missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when a buffer is supplied). No xcode release fixes this yet (only unpublished nightlies), so the transitive uuid is overridden straight to the patched 11.1.1 — devDependency-only, iOS build tooling, not shipped in the app bundle. Revisit once xcode ships a release with a fixed uuid. nanoid is pulled in transitively by vite's postcss dependency; overridden to 3.3.18 to fix GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 (high: custom generators loop indefinitely when size is zero) — drop the override once vite's postcss range picks it up on its own.
comments.patches: patches/ (applied by the postinstall patch-package run) fixes a production Android crash in @capacitor-community/background-geolocation: its handleOnPause/handleOnResume called Bridge.getPermissionStates, which NPEs during some activity pause/teardown sequences ('Unable to pause activity', Bridge.java:1217). The version is pinned exactly so the patch always matches; when bumping it, re-check whether upstream fixed the lifecycle permission check and regenerate or drop the patch.
